name: coord
description: Lets Claude Code sessions under any login on this machine see each other, exchange messages and claim shared resources through a shared folder.

root.title: Coordination folder
root.description: Absolute path every participating session shares; empty means $HOME/.claude-coord.

inbound.title: Incoming messages
inbound.description: deliver: hand each message to the model as it arrives. notify: toast only; /coord read delivers them.
